reason: The quote follow-up and missed-call log is my actual problem, jobs leak out the back door every week and I know it. He is asking for a page on my business before any meeting, and the balance is held back until a test passes, so the risk on the front end is my time, not a retainer check. I would bite on the $950 narrow fix first, not the $2,500 workflow.
objection: Last time I paid monthly for a year and got reports about clicks while my phone stayed quiet. Written test sounds good until we get to writing it, and then it is me in a meeting arguing about what counts as a followed-up quote. Say it in booked jobs and dollars, not dashboard numbers, or I am out.
would_change_my_mind: If he wants a 12-month commitment, a monthly retainer, or will not put the pass/fail test in plain numbers off my own phone log and books, I delete the page and stop answering.
